div.head: “Awake Catholics!”
div.p: The Protestant minister and principal of the American college is collecting a sum in gold for the construction of a building for said college. No one is so foolish as not to believe that that college is for the propagation of Protestantism, although they deny it, and surely no Catholic will commit the terror of aiding with his money, even though in form of a loan, the work of heresy. It is good that the foreigners here, who are almost all of them Protestants or Jews, should contribute; but that one of our fellow-countrymen, a son of a country so catholic as Colombia, should help the Yankee Protestants to sow the seed of disbelief in the minds of the youth, to say the least of it, with all its fatal consequences, thus preparing the way to Americanism, is not only sinning against religion, but also against society and against our native country.
Awake, Catholics and Colombians! Do not be deceived! Have no respect for any man! Before this, our country; and before our country, God.
